setup-worktree: echo 'Setting up worktree for Nissan GTR Auto ERP'
if [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm install 2>/dev/null || npm install 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [ -f $ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/supabase/config.toml ] && [ ! -f supabase/config.toml ]; then cp -r $ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/supabase/config.toml supabase/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi
